values.note: 'First come first serve camping only. Visitors can pay with cash or check at the fee tube.' Check-in 4 pm, check-out 2 pm. Forest-wide order: no more than 14 days camping within any 30-day period.

note: USFS Uwharrie NF (Uwharrie Ranger District), a very rustic campground 2 miles up Ophir Road from NC-109 at Uwharrie; a 0.75-mile trail joins the Uwharrie National Recreation Trail. Bring water and a cookstove. --Claude
